correctness.rationale: Directly reconstruct all 16 graph vertices, 80 independent edges, 144 triangles and 80 tetrahedra; explicit signed chain Z is a closed 3-cycle by 9 by 5 orbit boundary certificate and checks over each triangle. Exact rank of the full 144 by 80 boundary mod 2 is 79; the nonzero integral cycle bounds its rational rank by 79, so the rational top kernel is a line. All coefficients nonzero and gcd 1 give its complete integral lattice and universal facet support. Direct oriented group-action checks show all 32 dihedral maps fix Z, while rational finite-group cellular coinvariants yield the claimed quotient homology. The included executable reconstructs the complete finite chain complex. No extrapolation is required.

Relevant published-finding corpus items concern different complexes or weaker invariants; publication priority is conditional on indexed coverage and remains open to unindexed equivalents.

value.rationale: The sixteen-vertex circulant is the established minimal shellable-but-non-vertex-decomposable example, giving an independently motivated canonical object. The primitive top generator has support on every one of 80 facets and has forced nonunit coefficients on exactly sixteen, proving facet-essentiality and non-pseudomanifold incidence; its full dihedral invariance yields nontrivial rational homology of the ordinary quotient. These are structural cycle and symmetry facts not dictated by shellability, the face vector, or a top Betti number.
